streams.name: Paint Creek
species: rainbow trout (juvenile, from steelhead via Yates bypass)
streams.reproduction: Both: natural brown trout reproduction documented (2017 DNR survey: ~130/mi above Gunn, ~400/mi below) plus stocked yearlings
streams.dnr: Designated trout stream (FO-210) Lake Orion Dam to Clinton confluence; Type 1, Gunn Rd-Tienken Rd (5 mi) gear-restricted (FO-200)

season.label: Type 1: last Sat in April – Sep 30

streams.regs: Season last Sat in April-Sep 30 (closed now; 2027 opener Apr 24). Gunn-Tienken: artificial lures only, 2 trout, 14" min. Access via Paint Creek Trail.
streams.seasons_text: Opener to mid-June (best), September; July-Aug warm/tough (~70F).
streams.stocking_summary: DNR DB: 25,175 brown trout yearlings in 5 stockings: 2022-05-05, 2023-04-24, 2024-04-15, 2025-04-22, 2026-04-30 at Village Park, Clarkston/Kern, Adams, Tienken, Rochester City Park

catches.text: first trout on fly (spot not stated)

streams.access: Paint Creek Trail @ Tienken Rd / Rochester Municipal Park; upper: Village Park Lake Orion

streams.name: Huron River below Proud Lake Dam (Proud Lake Rec. Area / Milford)
streams.reproduction: Stocked only (retired hatchery broodstock, 13-20 in); no wild reproduction documented in sources

tr.note: TroutRoutes: Huron River upper (Proud Lake/Commerce/Milford) Class 1, GR, Type 1

streams.dnr: GR section dam to 100 yds below Wixom Rd (FO-200): Apr 1-Fri before last Sat Apr flies-only, zero possession; then Type 1 to Sep 30. FO-210 designates Huron from Main St Milford upstream to Moss Lake outlet.

season.label: Closed Oct 1 – Mar 31; Apr 1–25 flies-only catch & release, then open to Sep 30

streams.regs: Closed Oct 1-Mar 31. Apr 1-25 flies only C&R (kids <12 may keep 1 trout 8-12"). From Apr 26 all baits, 5 trout >8" (max 3 >15"). MI "Do Not Eat" fish advisory on Huron River N. Wixom Rd to I-275 (all fish incl. trout) - check Eat Safe Fish guide.
streams.seasons_text: Spring only effectively (stocked late March; open Apr 1-Sep 30); fish pressure drops after May.
streams.stocking_summary: DNR DB: 15,491 fish 2022-2026 (7,384 brown + 8,107 rainbow; adults 13-20 in) late March each year. 2026: ~990 brown + 1,430 rainbow (2026-03-30); 2025: ~1,950 brown + 1,350 rainbow

catches.text: rainbow trout, Huron River Commerce Twp (likely this reach)
large brown trout in kid's net, Proud Lake

streams.access: Proud Lake State Rec Area (Wixom Rd); Milford village

streams.name: Huron River - Flat Rock / Rockwood steelhead (lower river)

tr.note: TroutRoutes: Huron lower (Belleville to Flat Rock/Rockwood) Class 2, Type 4

streams.dnr: Not a designated trout stream; stocked steelhead river (regs not verified)
streams.regs: Not verified for this reach - check Michigan Fishing Guide. Flat Rock Dam has Denil fishway; partial removal recommended Aug 2025, not implemented.
streams.seasons_text: Spring run stronger (Mar-Apr); fall run from late Sep (small fish), bigger fish Nov when water ~40F; wind (east=rise, west=drop) affects lower river.
streams.stocking_summary: DNR DB: 273,094 steelhead smolts 2022-2026 (~50-60k/yr at Rockwood; e.g., 2026-04-10). DNR biologist: largest SE MI steelhead plant, est. run 3,000-5,000 fish

catches.text: poor, low drought water; occasional early skippers; bigger fish expected Nov

streams.access: Below Flat Rock Dam; Rockwood; French Landing to Flat Rock public parks; boat launches
